companies.name: LGエナジーソリューション

relations.text: 電池セル生産のUltium Cellsを折半出資の合弁として運営している
relations.text_en: Ultium Cells, the battery cell producer, is run as an equally owned joint venture

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our EV portfolio takes advantage of integrated supply chain development, including battery cell production from Ultium Cells Holdings LLC (a joint venture with LG Energy Solution) in plants in Warren, Ohio and Spring Hill, Tennessee.

relations.text: 中国の合弁SGMをSAICと50%ずつで設立した
relations.text_en: SGM was set up with SAIC, with SAIC holding 50%

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: SGM is a joint venture we established with Shanghai Automotive Industry Corporation (SAIC) ( 50 %).

relations.text: 2017年にオペル/ボクスホール事業を売却した相手で、補償義務が残る
relations.text_en: Stellantis bought the Opel/Vauxhall business in 2017, and GM retains indemnification obligations

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In 2017, we sold the Opel/Vauxhall Business to PSA Group, now Stellantis N.V. (Stellantis), under a Master Agreement (the Agreement).

relations.text_en: GM has made an investment in Lithium Americas

source.label: GM 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: $(0.3) billion investment in Lithium Americas in the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023

companies.name: ストラテック・セキュリティ
companies.sub: 自動車部品(鍵・ドア機構)

relations.text: 売上の27%がGM向け(2026年度の最大顧客)
relations.text_en: GM was its largest customer at 27% of fiscal 2026 sales

source.label: Strattec Security 10-K
source.quote: In fiscal 2026, our three largest customers, General Motors Company, Ford Motor Company and Stellantis, accounted for 27%, 21% and 16%, respectively, of our annual sales.

relations.text: シート部門の上位5顧客の1社としてGMを記載
relations.text_en: Lists GM among the top five customers of its Seating segment

source.label: Lear 10-K
source.quote: The top five customers of our Seating segment are: General Motors, Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, Volkswagen and BMW.

relations.text: 最終顧客の自動車メーカーとしてGMを記載
relations.text_en: Lists GM among its ultimate vehicle-maker customers

source.label: Visteon 10-K
source.quote: The Company's ultimate customers are global vehicle manufacturers including BMW, Ford, Geely, General Motors, Honda, Jaguar/Land Rover, Mahindra, Mazda, Mercedes-Benz, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Renault, Stellantis, Tata, Toyota, and Volkswagen.

relations.text: ボートのエンジンブロックをGMから調達する供給契約(2026年まで)
relations.text_en: Buys engine blocks from GM under a supply agreement through 2026

source.label: Malibu Boats 10-K
source.quote: We have an engine supply agreement with General Motors LLC ("General Motors") for the supply of engine blocks to use in our Malibu and Axis brand boats through calendar year 2026

source.quote: These customers include General Motors LLC (GM), Scania, Automotive Cells Company
